title: Congress trades
description: Stock trades that members of the House disclose under the STOCK Act, read from the Clerk's Periodic Transaction Reports.
note: Public disclosures, delayed up to 45 days after the trade. Amounts are ranges. Not inside information.
refreshNone: No new filings since the last check.

notify.label: Notify me when a new filing mentions my watchlist
notify.hint: Covers your watchlist and the positions you hold. Each filing notifies once.

empty.title: No trades match
empty.description: Change the filters, or check for new filings.

unread.title: Filings not read into rows
unread.description: These reports could not be read automatically (pdftotext is not installed, or the filing is a scanned paper form). Open the PDF to read it.

notification.title: New Congress filing: {{member}}
